card.name: Linking words in book and story descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (of, about, a comma, a period) inside descriptions of a book's or collection's contents, as in 'descriptions of', 'stories about', or 'revolving around'. Also fires on list markers and spaces before numbers in lists of volumes or quiz options.

modes.label: Describing contents
modes.description: Linking words like of, about, or revolving that introduce the subject matter of a book or story.

modes.label: Lists and numbering
modes.description: Punctuation or spaces in numbered lists, quiz options, or volume and verse references.
modes.example: Jem's favorite sport was a. soccer b. tennis c<<.>> baseball d. football 28.
